scope: Close the parity gap with Python Astrbot. 36 tasks tagged P0/P1/P2.
strategy: P0 lands the WASM plugin sandbox foundation, fills five highest-value Wave1 platforms, completes Dashboard chat/config/forms surface, and brings MCP to functional parity (stdio + http). P1 migrates the 13 builtin_stars, deepens KB/memory/T2I, fleshes out remaining dashboard surfaces, and adds Pipeline safety-check depth. P2 covers Computer Sandbox (subprocess + OS isolation), third-party agent proxies, residual Wave1 adapters, Prometheus metrics, Updater, Skills system body, Playwright e2e, and the optional personal-WeChat adapter. Tasks are ordered so that scaffolding (WASM ABI, schema-form engine, MCP transport) precedes content (plugin migrations, individual pages, individual platforms).
ordering_rationale: P0 first because it unblocks downstream P1/P2: WASM ABI must exist before any star migrates to it (TASK-P1-001..006); schema-form engine must exist before Provider/Platform pages get real forms (TASK-P0-012 unblocks TASK-P1-010..012); MCP transport must work before tools surfaced via MCP can be exercised. Within P0, sandbox + dashboard + platforms + MCP are roughly parallel; pick whichever has highest momentum. Within P1, builtin_stars come first because they unlock the largest user-visible behavior surface. P2 is acknowledged backlog, not a commitment.
